|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[Coruscant (V) (Dark)]] (version 2 of 2). The image here is the slip on the Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf) (PDF created 26 December 2025), cut unchanged from page 2. This is the current text. Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Coruscant (V) (Dark)]]): Players Committee card image first published 2 December 2025<ref name="ht-d7881b2">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual26-Dark/large/coruscant.gif</code> as published 2 December 2025: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/d7881b28d79e33541236559133b4d9583b43812d/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual26-Dark/large/coruscant.gif holotable commit d7881b2] “Fixing case and making gifs” (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “'''Light Side:''' While Invisible Hand controls this system, Menace Fades is suspended. '''Dark Side:''' Invisible Hand is hyperspeed +3 when moving to or from here. Your [Episode I] pilots deploy -1 here.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata (Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf)<ref name="sheet26-20251226">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, December 2025”; file created 26 December 2025). Released with [[Virtual Set 26]] (8 December 2025); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 26 December 2025: “'''Light Side:''' While Invisible Hand controls this system, Menace Fades is suspended. '''Dark Side:''' Invisible Hand is hyperspeed +3 when moving to or from here. Your [Episode I] pilots deploy -1 here.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Coruscant (V) (Dark)]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Coruscant (V) (Dark)]] (published 2 December 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Coruscant (Special Edition) (DARK)”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
